newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain approves law to rule out budget shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Spain approves law to rule out budget shortfall.

text.p: The Spanish cabinet approved on Friday measures intended to rule out unexpected shortfalls in the public budget, a government spokesman told a news conference.
"This is a development of the budget discipline law and it aims to adjust the procedure allowing expenditures allocation to specific budget years," government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez said.
In July 1996, Spain discovered a surprise shortfall in its public budget deficit.
"This a step toward control and transparency of the government on the budget," he said.
